arxiv-2105-09477.title: Deep learning for solution and inversion of structural mechanics and vibrations Thanks: A preprint to be published in: Modeling and Computations in Vibration Problems , Edited by S. Chakraverty, F. Tornabene, J. N. Reddy, Institute of Physics Publishing. 2021.
arxiv-2105-09477.creator: Ehsan Haghighat, Ali C. Bekar, Erdogan Madenci, Ruben Juanes
arxiv-2105-09477.description: Abstract Deep learning has been the most popular machine learning method in the last few years. In this chapter, we present the application of deep learning and physics-informed neural networks concerning structural mechanics and vibration problems. Demonstration problems involve de-noising data, solution to time-dependent ordinary and partial differential equations, and characterizing the system’s response for a given data.

arxiv-2109-14673.title: Joint Information and Mechanism Design for Queues with Heterogeneous Users
arxiv-2109-14673.creator: Nasimeh Heydaribeni, Achilleas Anastasopoulos
arxiv-2109-14673.description: Abstract We consider a queue with an unobservable backlog by the incoming users. There is an information designer that observes the queue backlog and makes recommendations to the users arriving at the queue whether to join or not to join the queue. The arriving users have payoff relevant private types.

arxiv-2111-03278.title: Agreement Implies Accuracy for Substitutable Signals
arxiv-2111-03278.creator: Rafael Frongillo, Eric Neyman, Bo Waggoner
arxiv-2111-03278.description: Abstract Inspired by Aumann’s agreement theorem, [ Aar05 ] studied the amount of communication necessary for two Bayesian experts to approximately agree on the expectation of a random variable. Aaronson showed that, remarkably, the number of bits does not depend on the amount of information available to each expert.

arxiv-2209-01056.title: Argument for the radiation-dominated behavior of matter fields in the preinflationary era
arxiv-2209-01056.creator: Taylor M. Ordines, Eric D. Carlson
arxiv-2209-01056.description: Abstract We investigate the leading-order behavior of matter fields in the preinflationary era using the semiclassical approximation. Many inflationary models assume without supporting arguments that the Universe was radiation dominated prior to inflation, leading to modifications of cosmological observables, such as the Cosmic Microwave Background power spectrum.

arxiv-2309-09589.title: Maximum-likelihood fits of piece-wise Pareto distributions with finite and non-zero core
arxiv-2309-09589.creator: Benjamin F. Maier
arxiv-2309-09589.description: Abstract We discuss multiple classes of piece-wise Pareto-like power law probability density functions p ⁡ ( x ) p(x) with two regimes, a non-pathological core with non-zero, finite values for support 0 ≤ x ≤ x min 0\leq x\leq x_{\mathrm{min}} and a power-law tail with exponent − α -\alpha for x > x min x>x_{\mathrm{min}} .

arxiv-2401-07997.title: Differentiation of Linear Optical Circuits
arxiv-2401-07997.creator: Giovanni de Felice, Christopher Corlett
arxiv-2401-07997.description: Abstract Linear optical circuits with single-photon sources offer a promising platform for quantum chemistry and machine learning. However, current applications are all based on support vector machines or gradient-free optimization methods. This paper develops classical and quantum algorithms for evaluating the analytic gradients of linear optical circuits with respect to their phase parameters.

arxiv-2406-09772.title: Accelerated Over-Relaxation Heavy-Ball Method: Achieving Global Accelerated Convergence with Broad Generalization
arxiv-2406-09772.creator: Jingrong Wei, Long Chen
arxiv-2406-09772.description: Abstract The heavy-ball momentum method accelerates gradient descent with a momentum term but lacks accelerated convergence for general smooth strongly convex problems. This work introduces the Accelerated Over-Relaxation Heavy-Ball (AOR-HB) method, the first variant with provable global and accelerated convergence for such problems.

arxiv-2501-07769.title: BMIP: Bi-directional Modality Interaction Prompt Learning for VLM
arxiv-2501-07769.creator: Song-Lin Lv, Yu-Yang Chen, Zhi Zhou, Ming Yang, Lan-Zhe Guo
arxiv-2501-07769.description: Abstract Vision-language models (VLMs) have exhibited remarkable generalization capabilities, and prompt learning for VLMs has attracted great attention for the ability to adapt pre-trained VLMs to specific downstream tasks. However, existing studies mainly focus on single-modal prompts or uni-directional modality interaction, overlooking the powerful alignment effects resulting from the interaction between the vision and language modalities.

arxiv-2506-22279.title: From Density Functional Theory to Spin Hamiltonians: Magnetism in d 5 d^{5} Honeycomb Compound OsCl 3
arxiv-2506-22279.creator: Ritwik Das, Indra Dasgupta
arxiv-2506-22279.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ritwik Das, Indra Dasgupta. Magnetism in strongly correlated honeycomb systems with d 5 d^{5} electronic configuration has garnered significant attention due to its potential to realize the Kitaev spin liquid state, characterized by exotic properties. However, real materials exhibit not only Kitaev exchange interactions but also other magnetic exchanges, which may drive the transition from a spin liquid phase to a long-range ordered ground state.

arxiv-2512-20911.title: footnoteinfo
arxiv-2512-20911.creator: Jing Guo, Xiushan Jiang, Weihai Zhang
arxiv-2512-20911.description: Abstract This paper investigates a model-free solution to the stochastic linear quadratic regulation (LQR) problem for linear discrete-time systems with both multiplicative and additive noises. We formulate the stochastic LQR problem as a nonconvex optimization problem and rigorously analyze its dual problem structure.

arxiv-2512-21963.title: Topological properties of generalized Markoff mod p p graphs
arxiv-2512-21963.creator: Shohei Satake, Yoshinori Yamasaki
arxiv-2512-21963.description: Abstract . The generalized Markoff mod p p graph is defined via the equation x 2 + y 2 + z 2 = x ​ y ​ z + κ x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=xyz+\kappa over the finite field 𝔽 p \mathbb{F}_{p} of prime order p p .

arxiv-2602-21765.title: Generalisation of RLHF under Reward Shift and Clipped KL Regularisation
arxiv-2602-21765.creator: Kenton Tang, Yuzhu Chen, Fengxiang He
arxiv-2602-21765.description: Abstract Alignment and adaptation in large language models heavily rely on reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF); yet, theoretical understanding of its generalisability remains premature, especially when the learned reward could shift, and the KL control is estimated and clipped.

arxiv-2603-06309.title: Quasi-twisted codes and their connection with additive constacyclic codes over finite fields
arxiv-2603-06309.creator: Kanat Abdukhalikov and Gyanendra K. Verma Department of Mathematical Sciences, UAE University, PO Box 15551, Al Ain, UAE

arxiv-2604-27260.creator: Gennadiy Averkov, Giulia Codenotti, Ansgar Freyer, Kyle Huang

pmc-10583098.title: Polygenic risk score predicts risk of primary sclerosing cholangitis in inflammatory bowel disease
pmc-10583098.creator: Ming-Hsi Wang, Jessica J Friton, Laura E Raffals, Jonathan A Leighton, Shabana F Pasha, Michael F Picco, Kelly Monroe, Billy D Nix, Rodney D Newberry, William A Faubion
pmc-10583098.description: BackgroundForty distinct primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) genomic loci have been identified through multiancestry meta-analyses. The polygenic risk score (PRS) could serve as a promising tool to discover unique disease behaviour, like PSC, underlying inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).AimTo test whether PRS indicates PSC risk in patients with IBD.

pmc-10744237.title: Liver-Directed Therapy in Neuroendocrine Neoplasms Metastatic to Both Liver and Bone
pmc-10744237.creator: Kristen E. Limbach, Kelly M. Mahuron, Aaron T. Scott, Philip H. G. Ituarte, Gagandeep Singh
pmc-10744237.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Bone metastases from gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms (GEPNENs) have been associated with poor prognosis, but it is unclear whether patients with concurrent bone metastases who receive liver-directed therapy (LDT) would derive survival benefit. The California Cancer Registry dataset, merged with data from the California Office of Statewide Health Planning and Development, was used to perform a retrospective study of GEPNENs metastatic to both liver and bone between 2000 and 2012. A total of 203 patients were identified.

pmc-11288073.title: Professional competencies in geriatric nursing for geriatric nurses: a latent profile analysis
pmc-11288073.creator: Mengxue Wang, Dongdong Li, Jingjing Li, Xiumei Zhang
pmc-11288073.description: BackgroundAs the global population continues to age, social realities such as advanced age, disability and living alone are coming to the fore, and the demand for medical care and health services for the elderly is increasing dramatically, especially in geriatrics.

pmc-11302348.title: Filicide in Africa: a systematic review
pmc-11302348.creator: Joseph Mayanja Ssekitto, Joan Abaatyo, Angella Namatovu, Rita Akatusasira, Emmanuel Kibet, Stanley Githaiga Kamau, Mark Mohan Kaggwa
pmc-11302348.description: BackgroundFilicide, the act of a parent or parental figure killing their child, has been reported in various African countries. However, there is a lack of comprehensive reviews on the prevalence and associated factors of filicide across the African continent, which is characterized by diverse cultural beliefs and practices.

pmc-11468284.title: Beyond Earth’s bounds: navigating the frontiers of Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART) in space
pmc-11468284.creator: Olga Chaplia, Begum Aydogan Mathyk, Stephanie Nichols-Burns, Murat Basar, Cihan Halicigil
pmc-11468284.description: As interest in deep space travel grows exponentially, understanding human adaptation in becoming an interplanetary species is crucial. This includes the prospect of reproduction. This review summarizes recent updates and innovations in assisted reproductive technologies (ART) on Earth, while also discussing current challenges and areas for improvement in adapting ART studies to the space environment.

pmc-11591166.title: Ethyl Acetate Fraction of Chestnut Honey Attenuates Scopolamine-Induced Cognitive Impairment in Mice and Glutamate-Induced Neurotoxicity in HT22 Cells
pmc-11591166.creator: Yun Hee Jeong, Wei Li, Hye Jin Yang, Se-Gun Kim, Hong Min Choi, Jang-Gi Choi, You-Chang Oh, Mercedes Villacampa
pmc-11591166.description: Chestnut honey has various benefits, such as antioxidative, anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, antibacterial, and antiviral effects. However, the effects of chestnut honey or the ethyl acetate fraction of chestnut honey (EACH) on neurodegenerative diseases and their related cognitive impairment and neurotoxicity have not yet been established.

pmc-11594240.title: Effects of Red Vinasse on Physicochemical Qualities of Blue Round Scad (Decapterus maruadsi) During Storage, and Shelf Life Prediction
pmc-11594240.creator: Shan Xue, Shuyi Chen, Bohu Liu, Jia Liu, Thierry Astruc
pmc-11594240.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A fish processed with red vinasse is a type of Fujian cuisine with regional characteristics. In order to monitor the effect of red vinasse on storage quality and shelf life of blue round scad (Decapterus maruadsi) during storage, the changes in fat content, thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS), composition of polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), pH value, texture, and sensory quality were studied at different storage temperatures (4 °C, 25 °C, and 37 °C).

pmc-11663786.title: Response to the Letter regarding the EBIOM-D-23-04056: “CPAP may promote an endothelial inflammatory milieu in sleep apnoea after coronary revascularization”
pmc-11663786.creator: Yuksel Peker, Yeliz Celik, Afrouz Behboudi, Susan Redline, Daniel J Gottlieb, Sanja Jelic
pmc-11663786.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). in patients with obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) after coronary revascularization, consistent with two prior studies showing increases in angiopoietin-2 following CPAP initiation.1, 2, 3 These findings suggest a plausible explanation for the failure of randomized controlled trials to demonstrate a reduced risk of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease (CVD) events with CPAP, which is the unequivocal finding of the cited meta-analysis of the RICCADSA, ISAACC, and SAVE trials that found an overall hazard ratio for the impact of CPAP on major adverse cardiovascular

pmc-12447796.title: Decomposing Intolerance of Uncertainty: No Association With Affective Decision Making in a Community Sample
pmc-12447796.creator: Yannik Paul, Anya Pedersen, Kamil Fuławka
pmc-12447796.description: Intolerance of Uncertainty (IU) is a transdiagnostic factor in psychological disorders, yet its underlying psychological mechanisms remain unclear. To close this gap, we first identify three potential mechanisms from existing definitions of IU: (1) negativity overweighting, (2) probability distortion, and (3) information deficit aversion.

pmc-12581326.title: Utilization of vector bionomics, remote sensing and larval habitat characterization data to inform larval source management decision in the high malaria burden state of Kebbi, Nigeria
pmc-12581326.creator: Adedayo O. Oduola, Petrus U. Inyama, Lazarus M. Samdi, Muhammad A. Bunza, Abubakar Bagudu, Ifeanyi Okeke, Grace Yina, Mary Esema, Godwin Ntadom, Kelley Ambrose, Jules Mihigo, Melissa Yoshimizu, Aklilu Seyoum
pmc-12581326.description: BackgroundMalaria remains a public health challenge with Nigeria having the highest burden in cases and deaths worldwide. Increased outdoor and indoor biting of Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (s.l.) and large gaps in protection have become emerging challenges threatening malaria control efforts in Kebbi State, Nigeria.

pmc-12595671.title: Risk of Parkinson’s disease after human papillomavirus infection: a nationwide cohort study
pmc-12595671.creator: Tien-Wei Hsu, Chih-Wei Hsu, Yu-Chen Kao, Shih-Jen Tsai, Ya-Mei Bai, Tung-Ping Su, Tzeng-Ji Chen, Mu-Hong Chen, Chih-Sung Liang
pmc-12595671.description: BackgroundLittle is known about the association between human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and Parkinson’s disease (PD). This study aimed to explore the risk of incident PD following HPV infection.MethodsPatients 40 years or older with HPV infection diagnosed between 1996 and 2013 were included in the case group and were 1:4 matched with controls from the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database.

pmc-12787933.title: Biofortification of Vegetables with Iodine and Molybdenum for Healthy Nutrition: A Controlled Trial
pmc-12787933.creator: Sara Baldassano, Luigi Di Rosa, Cristina Cortis, Alessia Cannizzaro, Antonino Salvatore Fiore, Leo Sabatino, Sonya Vasto, Patrizia Proia
pmc-12787933.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Excessive sugar, fat, and salt intake heighten susceptibility to metabolic syndrome and other chronic metabolic conditions. Biofortification (i.e., enhancing the nutritional content of crops) emerges as a sustainable new approach to address dietary deficiencies.

pmc-13356721.title: Digital Analysis of Upper Airway Morphology in Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome Using Cone Beam Computed Tomography
pmc-13356721.creator: Yiyu Zeng, Zhengrong Gao, Yingjun Zhang, Qian Yang, Wenhui Ge, Mengmeng Li, Xinying Wang, Yi Yu, Xiaoyan Xie, Shisheng Li
pmc-13356721.description: Introduction and aimsObstructive sleep apnea syndrome (OSAS) is one of the most common sleep disorders, which poses a serious burden on the quality of life of the population. The incidence rate of OSAS in the population is very high and most cases have not been confirmed in time.

pmc-13396691.title: FgCot1 Regulates Polarized Growth and Conidiation in Fusarium graminearum via Gpmk1 MAPK and Tsf1 Transcriptional Pathways
pmc-13396691.creator: Chengliang Li, Shaozhe Qin, Daiyuan Sun, Jingyi Ren, Cong Jiang, Jin‐Rong Xu, Guanghui Wang
pmc-13396691.description: Fusarium graminearum causes Fusarium head blight (FHB), a devastating wheat disease that threatens global food security and safety. Nuclear Dbf2‐related (NDR) kinases regulate cellular morphogenesis, but their roles in phytopathogenic fungi remain elusive. Here, we characterized F. graminearum NDR kinase FgCot1, whose deletion severely disrupted vegetative growth, conidiation, polarized growth and pathogenicity.
